scope: Finite offline product-string/default-key block-cipher hypotheses; padding recognition only, no decoded firmware or device writes
self_tests: TEA, XTEA, DES known zero vectors plus TEA/XTEA nonzero roundtrips
limitations: No hit excludes only these keys/ciphers/rounds and tested padding patterns. Does not establish chip or cipher, prove encryption, or exhaust keys. Any candidate still requires full independent checksums and architecture validation.
